notes: Basalt "Stonehide Plating Bay": a stone cradle with a pale polished slab lying between two iron presses; on loop (2): the presses close on the slab and a magma seam runs along it, then they open. A stack of finished plates sits in the corner. Damaged: a press arm bent, the slab chipped with a crack leaking light, sparks. Disabled: presses jammed open, the slab split, plates scattered, cold seams.
